faq_heading: East Central condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in East Central. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

East Central, Maple Ridge: 120 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 11 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 1 of 12 Maple Ridge communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Maple Ridge total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in East Central rose from 112 in June to 120 in September (+7.1%), and 68 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 42.0% of Maple Ridge’s 286 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in East Central?
East Central also had 82 houses listed and 5 sold in September, against 120 condos and townhomes listed. The East Central houses page has those figures.

blocks.text: East Central home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

114 condos sold in East Central with a median price of $482,500 (the middle half sold between $400,000 and $557,500), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 97.3% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $540 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $380 a month. 71 townhomes sold in East Central with a median price of $700,000 (the middle half sold between $625,000 and $762,500), taking a median of 24 days to sell at 98.0% of the last list price; 7% sold above list. They had a median $479 per square foot, a median year built of 1997 and a median strata fee of $393 a month.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in East Central?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 120 condos and townhomes listed in East Central. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is East Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in East Central had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in East Central from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 68 condos and townhomes sold in East Central over those 4 months, out of 184 in all of Maple Ridge.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.

faq.q: What did condos in East Central sell for?
faq.a: 114 condos sold in East Central between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $482,500.

faq.q: How long do condos take to sell in East Central?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.3% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
